page_title: INT 2-2 CAG | Inter v Cagliari 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' What a save from Yann Sommer! Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90+4' Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+3' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Adam Obert (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
88' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) replacing Pantelis Hatzidiakos.
86' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Bastoni goes off and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) comes on.
86' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
83' 2 - 2 Goal! Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
80' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
78' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
78' Zito Luvumbo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Alessandro Di Pardo and he is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
76' Here's the change. Federico Dimarco leaves the pitch and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
76' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Alexis Sanchez will be replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
75' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Darmian.
74' 2 - 1 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Simone Scuffet into the bottom right corner.
73' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
73' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

72' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) touches the ball with his hand. PENALTY to Inter! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
72' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
70' The ball has crossed the sideline. Inter are taking a throw-in.
67' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Henrikh Mkhitaryan can be given a rest.
63' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot that heads towards the left post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about.
63' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet is alert and thwarts the effort. Inter win a corner.
61' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yerry Mina (Cagliari).
61' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
60' Yann Bisseck (Inter) commits a foul during an attacking move.
60' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
56' Adam Obert (Cagliari) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Yann Sommer.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a chip pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet is quickest to intercept the ball.
52' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
48' Inter will take a corner kick.

48' Simone Scuffet makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Federico Dimarco (Inter) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the roof of the net.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
46' The whistle blows and Francesco Fourneau starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
42' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
41' A free kick from long distance is going to be taken by Inter.
40' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Matteo Prati (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
36' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Alexis Sanchez (Inter), but Simone Scuffet is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
33' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a throw-in.
31' The ball is cleared after Yann Bisseck (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Substitution. Matteo Prati (Cagliari) replaces Jakub Jankto.
28' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolo Barella (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
25' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
23' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
22' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
18' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
18' Inter earn a corner.
17' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save.
15' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
12' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Alexis Sanchez laid the ball off to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
11' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
11' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Marcus Thuram (Inter) heads on.

5' Nicolo Barella (Inter) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
5' The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
2' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
2' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has started.
Inter will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau is introduced as the referee for today's match.
